<NativeControlDiv
      data-slot="code-block-actions"
      data-motion={cm.mode}
      data-revealed={revealed || undefined}
      target={{ opacity: revealed ? 1 : 0 }}
      transition={cm.transition("data.transition")}
      className={cn(
        "absolute end-3 top-3 z-10 flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:end-2 group-data-[size=sm]/code-block:top-2",

        "[&_button]:bg-background [&_button]:ring-1 [&_button]:ring-foreground/10",
        // Invisible but still tabbable: focusing it reveals the row again.
        !revealed && "pointer-events-none",
        className,
      )}
      {...props}
    >

records.source:
<ControlSpan
              {...(rest as HTMLMotionProps<"span">)}
              ref={(node: HTMLSpanElement | null) => {
                thumbRef.current = node;
                if (typeof forwardedRef === "function") return forwardedRef(node);
                else if (forwardedRef) (forwardedRef as RefObject<HTMLSpanElement | null>).current = node;
              }}
              className={cn(
                "pointer-events-none block rounded-full bg-background ring-0",
                "group-data-[size=default]/switch:size-4 group-data-[size=sm]/switch:size-3",
                "dark:data-checked:bg-primary-foreground dark:data-unchecked:bg-foreground",
                thumbClassName,
              )}
              target={{ x: state.checked ? (travel ?? 0) : 0 }}
              // Until the measured distance has been painted, there is nothing to
              // animate *between*: jump into place, then spring on user input.
              transition={!settled || cm.reduced ? { duration: 0 } : cm.transition("state.morph")}
            />
